title: The diaphragm draws air into the lungs
summary: NIAMS says the diaphragm is a muscle that draws air into the lungs.
body: NIAMS calls the diaphragm a muscle that draws air into the lungs. The same page says that muscle also moves air for phonation. This card is the drawing of air into the lungs. Gas exchange is a different card. The description comes from the institute page about muscle, dated June 2025.

sources.title: Health Lesson: Learning About Muscles
sources.author: National Institute of Arthritis and Musculoskeletal and Skin Diseases
sources.note: US government page, public domain. Last Updated June 2025. Supports the diaphragm as a chest muscle that helps the lungs fill with air when you breathe.
